about: D12 The benchmark board and D13 Independent scoreboard: each slate race's independent against the best vote share an independent has ever received in that race. Set 2026-10-31 from the producer's email after the day's call; the metric is the same for all six. Senate races: the best independent result in any U.S. Senate race in that state. CA-6 is a new district under the 2025 map and no independent has made the November ballot in any of its predecessor districts since top-two primaries began (2012), so it has no number: first = true, and the boards call it FIRST, with tonight's share becoming the benchmark. Alaska: Alyse Galvin (2018, 2020) is excluded, she carried the Independent label as the Democratic nominee; Alaska is ranked choice, so Hill is compared on his first-round share, which is what AP's top-line pct is until the tabulation. pct null = still to be researched (the boards say so). countNote: what the scoreboard's status pill says while the race is counting and not called. Keyed by state; a race id key (e.g. "5696") overrides the state for that race.
